notes: Implemented Section 1 of the Phase 3 test plan: BackgroundRenderer unit tests. Created BackgroundRendererTest.html with 35 tests (94 assertions) covering: (1) Solid backgrounds — hex color, null/undefined/empty defaults to '#000000', invalid color passthrough, full canvas fillRect. (2) Gradient backgrounds — 5 angle tests (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°, 45°) with exact halfDiag math (1101.45 for 1920x1080), NaN angle defaults to 0°, null colors default to '#000000'/'#333333', square canvas symmetry. (3) Image backgrounds — opacity values (1.0, 0.5, 0.0, default), null image fallbacks to black fill, out-of-bounds opacity passthrough, save/restore verification. (4) Dispatcher edge cases — null/undefined/empty bgState no-ops, unknown type falls back to white, zero-size canvas handling. Used offscreen canvas as image source (Image.complete is read-only). Intercepted addColorStop on CanvasGradient objects returned by createLinearGradient. Updated references/testing.md with Canvas 2D Context Mocking section documenting the mock context factory pattern, property interception via Object.defineProperty, method wrapping, and gradient addColorStop interception. No new learnings document — patterns are incremental refinements of existing documentation.
